name: Personal Growth
overview: Scripture reveals that personal growth is a process empowered by God's grace and guided by His Word, which serves as a lamp illuminating the believer's path (Psalms 119:105). Despite challenges such as worldly cares and distractions that can hinder spiritual fruitfulness (Luke 8:14), believers are assured that God, who began a good work in them, will faithfully complete it (Philippians 1:6). Growth involves an increasing knowledge of God's will and wisdom, enabling a life that is fruitful and pleasing to the Lord (Colossians 1:9-10), and is sustained by faith through which we stand and rejoice in the hope of God's glory (Romans 5:2).
